sections.shortTitle: Balochistan Chief Minister and Provincial Ministers Salaries Allowances and Privileges Amendment Act 2008
sections.description:
Short title and Commencement

ACT II OF 2008
ACT II OF 2008
BALOCHISTAN CHIEF
MINISTER AND PROVINICAL
MINISTERS (SALARIES,
ALLOWANCES AND
PRILVILEGES)
(AMENDMENT) ACT 2008,
An Act further to amend
the Balochistan Chief Minister
& Provincial
Ministers (Salaries, Allowances and
Privileges)
Act, 1975) (III of 1975).
[Gazette of Balochistan Extraordinary
20th September, 2008]
No.PAB/Legis:V(2)/2008,
dated 20-9-2008.--Having been passed the Balochistan
Chief Minister and Provincial Ministers (Salaries, Allowances and Privileges)
(Amendment) Bill 2008 Bill No.2 of 2008, by the Provincial Assembly of Balochistan on 1st September, 2008 and assented to by the
Governor Balochistan on 16th September, 2008, is
hereby published as an Act of the Provincial Assembly.
Preamble. Whereas, it is expedient further to amend the Balochistan Chief Minister & Provincial Ministers
(Salaries, Allowances and Privileges) Act 1975, in the manner hereinafter
appearing;
It is hereby enacted as follows:--
1. Short title and Commencement.---(1)
This Act may be called the Balochistan Chief Minister
& Provincial Ministers (Salaries, Allowances and Privileges) (Amendment)
Act, 2008.
(2) It shall come into force at once.
